en: Hello, the month-end cost cut-off is {cutoff}. For {project} we accrue {amount} for {vendor}. Please book it and reverse it on {reverse_on}.
mt: Hallo, de maand-einde kosten cut-off is {cutoff}. voor {project} we accumuleren {amount} voor {vendor}.

en: Hello, we drew {amount} from the reserve of {project} on {date} for: {reason}. The reserve left is {left}. Approved by {approved_by}.
mt: Hallo, we trekken {amount} uit de reserve van {project} op {date} voor: {reason}.

en: Hello {sponsor}, please approve transfer {tr_id} on {project}: {amount} from {from_cat} to {to_cat}. Reason: {reason}.
mt: Hallo {sponsor}, geef toestemming voor de overdracht {tr_id} op {project}: {amount} van {from_cat} naar {to_cat}.

en: Hello {contact}, we sent invoice {invoice_no} for {amount} for the milestone {milestone} on {project}. It is due on {due}. Please tell us if anything is missing.
mt: Hallo {contact}, we hebben de factuur {invoice_no} voor {amount} voor de mijlpaal {milestone} op {project}.

en: Hello, the forecast of {project} is {over_by} above its budget and the cost index is {cpi}. The manager is {manager}. Please look at the recovery plan this week.
mt: Hallo, de prognose van {project} is {over_by} boven zijn budget en de kostenindex is {cpi}.

en: To date {col:projects.spent} is spent, which is {col:projects.used} of the budget now, and {col:projects.left} is left. The forecast cost at completion is {col:projects.eac}. The cost check shows: {col:projects.state}.
mt: Tot op heden is {col:projects.spent} uitgegeven, wat nu {col:projects.used} van het budget is, en {col:projects.left} is overgebleven. De verwachte kosten bij voltooiing zijn {col:projects.eac}.

en: The budget now is {col:forecast.bac}. The actual cost to date is {col:forecast.ac}, which is {col:forecast.used_pct} of the budget.
mt: De werkelijke kosten tot op heden zijn {col:forecast.ac}, dat is {col:forecast.used_pct} van de begroting.

en: The cost variance is {col:forecast.cv} and the schedule variance is {col:forecast.sv}. A negative figure means over cost or behind schedule.
mt: Een negatief cijfer betekent dat de kosten overschreden of achter de planning liggen.

en: Project: {col:forecast.project}. Project manager: {col:forecast.manager}. Sponsor: {col:forecast.sponsor}.
mt: Projectmanager: Sponsor:

en: The cost performance index is {col:forecast.cpi}: a value below 1 means each unit of money spent has earned less than a unit of planned work. The schedule performance index is {col:forecast.spi}: a value below 1 means the work is behind the plan.
mt: De kostenprestatie-index is {col:forecast.cpi}: een waarde onder 1 betekent dat elke uitgebrachte geldunit minder verdient dan een eenheid van het geplande werk.

en: The forecast at completion is {col:forecast.eac}, a variance of {col:forecast.vac} against the budget. The cost forecast shows: {col:forecast.state}.
mt: De prognose bij voltooiing is {col:forecast.eac}, een variantie van {col:forecast.vac} ten opzichte van het budget.

en: The budget now is {col:forecast.bac} and the actual cost is {col:forecast.ac}. The estimate to complete is {col:forecast.etc}, which includes {col:forecast.known} of known extra cost that is not yet booked.
mt: Het budget is nu {col:forecast.bac} en de werkelijke kosten zijn {col:forecast.ac}.

en: The price now is {col:forecast.price} and the margin at completion is {col:forecast.margin}. The cost forecast shows: {col:forecast.state}.
mt: De prijs is nu {col:forecast.price} en de marge bij voltooiing is {col:forecast.margin}.

en: Request {col:requests.req_id}: {col:requests.item}, for {col:requests.project}. Requested by {col:requests.requested_by}. Estimated amount {col:requests.amount}. Needed by {col:requests.needed_by}.
mt: Verzoek {col:requests.req_id}: {col:requests.item}, voor {col:requests.project}. Verzocht door {col:requests.requested_by}.

en: Each quote is scored out of 100 with these weights: price {set:w_price}, lead time {set:w_lead} and quality {set:w_quality}. The chosen vendor is {col:requests.chosen_vendor}, on order {col:requests.order}.
mt: Elke offerte wordt beoordeeld op 100 punten met de volgende gewichten: prijs {set:w_price}, doorlooptijd {set:w_lead} en kwaliteit {set:w_quality}.

en: Invoices are paid on average after {col:vendors.avg_days} days. There are {col:vendors.overdue} overdue invoices and {col:vendors.disputed} disputed invoices. The vendor check shows: {col:vendors.state}.
mt: De facturen worden gemiddeld na {col:vendors.avg_days} dagen betaald. Er zijn {col:vendors.overdue} achterstallige facturen en {col:vendors.disputed} betwiste facturen.

en: To: {col:changes.contact}, telephone {col:changes.client_phone}. Project: {col:changes.project}.
mt: Aan: {col:changes.contact}, telefoon {col:changes.client_phone}.

en: The change adds {col:changes.extra_days} working days and is priced at {col:changes.price}. The status is {col:changes.status}, decided on {col:changes.decided_on}.
mt: De wijziging voegt {col:changes.extra_days} werkdagen toe en wordt geprijsd op {col:changes.price}.

en: An amount of {col:contingency.amount} is drawn from the project reserve and moved to the category {col:contingency.category}. Reason: {col:contingency.reason}.
mt: Een bedrag van {col:contingency.amount} wordt uit de projectreserve getrokken en verplaatst naar de categorie {col:contingency.category}.

en: To: {col:projects.contact}, {col:projects.client}, telephone {col:projects.client_phone}. Project: {col:projects.name}.
mt: Aan: {col:projects.contact}, {col:projects.client}, telefoon {col:projects.client_phone}.

en: The contract price now is {col:projects.price_now}. We have billed {col:projects.billed} and you have paid {col:projects.paid}. The balance owed is {col:projects.owed}.
mt: We hebben {col:projects.billed} gefactureerd en u hebt {col:projects.paid} betaald.
